title: UPDATE AVAILABLE
message:
A new version of Music Square is available on Google Play!
Update now to enjoy the latest songs, daily missions, and performance improvements.
release_notes:
• 5 Distinct Modern Retro Background Themes with unique visual architecture
• Polished and uniform main menu button styling
• 3 Rotating Daily Missions with Neon Sparks rewards
• Cosmetic Customization Shop: trails, square skins, and hit sounds
• Google Play Games Services leaderboard integration
